subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this stacked draft remain a proof-only target until Telegram Desktop proof succeeds, or should maintainers accept or close the combined stack now?
rationale: The branch intentionally mixes the final implementation and proof harness to make one live proof run possible, and automation cannot decide whether skipped Mantis evidence is enough or whether the combined branch should ever be a landing boundary.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show the expected baseline/candidate generated-image delta.

options.title: Accept Combined Boundary
options.body: Merge the stack only if maintainers intentionally want the implementation, proof harness, and stack-only alignment in one landing change.

options.title: Close After Proof Is Unworkable Or Captured
options.body: Close this draft if the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario or after the useful proof is captured and preserved for the split PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show the expected baseline/candidate generated-image delta.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily about Telegram/Mantis proof sufficiency and proof-runner behavior, where this history shows recent ownership signal.
